description: Build a weekly study plan: enter subjects with weekly hours, pick your available days, and get a balanced day-by-day schedule.

faqs.a: Each subject's weekly hours are split into sessions of your chosen length and dealt round-robin across your available days, so no day is overloaded.
Yes — tick only the days you can study and all sessions land on those days.
faqs.q: Can I choose which days I study?

faqs.a: Sessions default to 45 minutes with a short break, which you can change. Shorter, regular sessions beat marathon cramming.
faqs.q: How long should each session be?

faqs.a: Yes, everything is computed locally in your browser.

howto: Add your subjects with the hours per week each needs.
Tick your available study days and set the session length.
Press Build plan to get your day-by-day schedule.
title: Study Plan Generator
